defects: Event venue wording 「嘉禾广场社区附近门店会议室」 is vague and awkward for an address line (cosmetic)

Realism note 「包装表面有少量冷冻霜花」 doesn't fit the carrier, which is an X-banner poster photo with no physical frozen pack specified
Frozen-food rule text and 「团圆佳节必备」 are shown under the 「开学季 能量补给」 theme during 2027.2.22—3.3, after the Lantern Festival (2027-02-20); the theme and copy don't quite match (cosmetic)
Free-entry outdoor farmers' market shows the tags 「免费入场」 with 「名额200个」 and the sign-up line 「关注公众号回复“报名”」; a quota and registration are odd for an open market
Contains 白砂糖, 蓝莓果酱 and 食用香精 yet typed 「产品类型：发酵乳」; under GB 19302 it should be 风味发酵乳 (unintended regulatory inaccuracy)
The 温度设置 column mixes in non-temperature items (「不要一次塞得太满」, 「少开门、快关门」) and repeats the subtitle 「冷藏2—8℃，冷冻-18℃以下」 verbatim as a bullet
Chinese public guidance usually gives the fridge chill range as 0—4℃/≤4℃; 2—8℃ reads like a pharmacy cold-chain range (pedantic)
Slogan 「扭一扭舔一舔」 plus a blue sleeve with sandwich-biscuit cross-section and milk-splash art closely copies Oreo's real trade dress and slogan, breaking the fictional-brand rule
A strawberry-flavour product in a blue milk-splash pack is a weak colour/flavour fit

Daily hours 「每日10:00—20:00」 but the agenda ends at 18:00 and has a 12:00—15:00 gap (cosmetic)
Brand 「闽屿臻选」 suggests Fujian, but the pork lunch meat is made in 银川/宁夏 (weak brand–origin fit, cosmetic)
Carrier is a 利乐砖 carton, but storage text says 「开罐后请立即饮用」 (and the deleted instruction referred to 「连罐」); 'can' wording on a carton is an unintended inconsistency
Calcium NRV% is wrong: 116/800 = 14.5, which rounds half-up to 15%, but the table gives 「钙｜116 mg｜14%」 (unintended)
Selling point 「每100mL含3.2g乳蛋白」 conflicts with the table 「蛋白质｜3.3 g」 and isn't listed in tamper_details
「北纬40°优质牧场奶源」 while the UHT milk is made in 赣州 (~26°N); plausible but weak
Agenda rows 「09:00—11:00｜慢病用药与饮食咨询」 and 「10:00—11:00｜营养师膳食咨询」 overlap; parallel sessions are plausible, but this is an untagged time conflict that could confuse labels
The deleted rule 「按登记顺序依次咨询」 is undetectable from the image alone
